ConversationSummary.title: ConversationSummary
ConversationSummary.description: Metadata and latest preview for an isolated Gaza curriculum package AI conversation thread.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the conversation owner.

stageId.description: Deterministic Gaza curriculum stage identifier (ASCII slug).

stageTitle.description: Arabic display title of the educational stage.

subjectTitle.description: Arabic display title of the subject package.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the most recent message in this package conversation.

messageCount.description: Total number of saved messages in this package conversation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when conversation is created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each message.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single user prompt or Gemini AI tutor reply stored inside a package conversation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

text.description: Message body text in Arabic or study notes.

imageUri.description: Optional attached local image URI string.

StudySummary.title: StudySummary
StudySummary.description: Cloud-synced student study summary tied to a Gaza curriculum stage and subject.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the summary owner.

stageTitle.description: Arabic display title of the educational stage.

subjectTitle.description: Arabic display title of the subject package.

keyTerms.description: Important keywords, laws, or formulas separated by bullets.

sourceType.description: Origin of the summary: manual user note, AI Lab, or Tutor explanation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on edits.
